text:
maya: Quick feedback request — I pushed a lightweight prototype for the new welcome path (compact rail + two CTA variants). Link: https://figma.com/file/xyz | please skim for CTA density and copy.

jon: :eyes: Nice, saw the rail. My first impression: too many primary-looking buttons. The left rail feels like it has 3 primaries — Start, Explore Samples, Use Templates. We should surface one primary + secondary actions.

sam: Agree with jon. Recommend collapsing 'Explore Samples' into a secondary dropdown and making 'Start' the single prominent CTA. Also think the microcopy for 'Start' is ambiguous — is it 'start project' or 'start tour'?

maya: Good point. Original intent was 'Start workspace' but I can see the confusion. Maybe 'Create workspace' vs 'Try sample project' as labels?

elaine: From a UX flow POV, 'Create workspace' is heavier than 'Start'. For new users 'Get started' might be friendlier. Also accessibility note: color contrast on the CTA gradient falls to 3.8:1 against white on small text — fails AA for 14px.

maya: thanks — noted contrast. a11y-bot, can you run the quick check for the gradient swatch?

a11y-bot: Automated check: gradient (#0a74ff -> #0047b3) on white at 12px text = 3.78:1. Recommendation: increase contrast by 8% or use solid #0047b3 for text. Also missing aria-label on the sample project card 'Open sample' button.

sam: Re: sample card affordance — current design uses two icons only (play + bookmark) with no visible label on hover. We should always show text label in compact view to avoid discovery problems.

jon: Also keyboard focus — tab order currently goes: primary CTA -> skip link -> sample cards. It should be: skip link -> primary CTA -> sample cards. I can attach a quick patch for focus order.

maya: please do. On copy: options I'm testing in figma: 'Get started', 'Create workspace', 'Try sample project'. Thoughts?

elaine: 'Get started' is the most approachable. Use 'Create workspace' only if the action immediately creates something heavy (like billing or long setup). If it's just a quick starter, 'Try sample project' for the other CTA is fine.

sam: +1 'Get started' + 'Try sample project'. But tweak microcopy under sample tiles: current blurb is long — shorten to one sentence and add estimated time, e.g., 'Deploy a chat demo — 3 min'.

jon: UX nit: the helper tooltip on first run appears after 1.5s hover — that's too eager. Let's bump to 500ms hover + focus-first open for keyboard.

maya: noted. I'll update tokens in figma + open a small PR for focus order and a11y fixes.

elaine: small accessibility nit: ensure buttons have descriptive screen reader text. e.g., instead of 'Open', use `aria-label="Open sample: Chat demo - 3 min"`.

maya: adding that to the PR description. Anyone object to making the rail a little thinner (reduce padding) so we don't push page content too far right on small widths?

sam: Thinner rail is fine as long as touch targets remain >= 44px.

jon: Also check responsive breakpoint at 768px — currently the rail collapses but leaves the primary CTA in the header which gets lost. Maybe move primary CTA inline with header on collapse.

maya: good call. I'll mock that. Plan: 1) primary CTA -> 'Get started', 2) secondary -> 'Try sample project' (with time), 3) fix contrast + aria-labels, 4) adjust focus order and tooltip delay, 5) ensure 44px touch targets. I'll open a PR with checklist and link out when ready.

sam: LGTM. Thanks Maya.

jon: :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all — will ping when PR is up.
